planets.name: TOI-4438 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-4438 with a 7.45-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-4438 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-4438. Its orbit and size follow Serrano Bell et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
